owner_instructions.instruction: Modify the code to provide the independent researcher a way to choose between the number of replicates (12, 21 or 33) just before running the whole experiment,provide 12 as default
the vm stopped, is there anything we need to continue or can you create a new release to register it on OSF?

authorized_scope: Complete interrupted offline validation, retain earlier transport/accounting fixes, publish the verified five-arm source and a new versioned freeze/release with a source-bound prospective OSF packet. Conditional on actual validation, not an instruction to bypass a failed check.

arms.A: 30-minute feature delivery only; 300 nominal credits / 270 soft.
arms.B: Ordinary feature followed by 15-minute behaviour-preserving consolidation, additional tests in new files and replacement DESIGN.md; post 300 nominal / 270 soft.
arms.C: Ordinary feature followed by 15-minute read-only review and replacement REVIEW.md; post 300 nominal / 270 soft.
arms.D: One uninterrupted 45-minute feature delivery session, 600 nominal / 540 soft; no post session. CR1 remains 45 minutes and 300 nominal / 270 soft.
arms.E: Ordinary feature followed by 15-minute repair of already-visible specified behaviour; post 300 nominal / 270 soft. No hidden feedback, future feature or early CR1 access.

replicates_per_model_arm.selection: Prospective, persisted, immutable on resume and never selected from observed outcomes.

independent_unit: Fresh repository trajectory, not its features, tests or sessions.
primary: Final P10 coverage, equal weights over all three within-model B-D mean differences. Whole trajectories resampled within model and arm, 10000 draws with seed2027, pointwise percentile intervals. Incomplete/assisted allocated frames or missing final coverage make the primary unavailable; no observed-model pooling or complete-case substitution.
historical_analysis: Historical ABC/v1 cohorts remain separately analyzed under their declared design; never relabelled, mixed or pooled into the five-arm frame.
accepted_tests: Accepted Python test files immutable in full; additions in new files. E alone may change literal expected values on the right of equality assertions in agent-authored tests, retaining every other byte and recording old/new blob hashes, exact already-visible specification id/quote and explanation. Examples and skeleton tests never qualify.
E_adjudication_limit: Provenance and quote validation are not independent semantic adjudication. Retain correction evidence in the private step journal and externally review alleged specification contradictions before interpreting corrections as justified.

resources.retry_rule: One documented infrastructure-only retry shares the original aggregate time/credit allowance; never retry poor outcomes or top up an exhausted/subminimum allowance.

power_limit: 12/21/33 correspond to conditional SD assumptions15/20/25points for a ten-point effect, not interchangeable80%-power guarantees or measured variance. No guaranteed power claim.
validation_policy: Final source-bound containment receipt and complete offline harness/SDK validation are required for publication. Evidence hashes/counts live in the immutable release packet and freeze manifest. Local tests are not hosted CI or independent human review.
historical_runtime_evidence: Unchanged image090220 retains earlier Expat-removal/build/scan proofs with their original dates/scopes. New source qualification does not relabel old scans or paid diagnostics as fresh five-arm paid validation.
remaining_collection_gates: Actual prospective OSF recording for the released five-arm source and selected allocation
Fresh operator access/model/effort/complete-billing and intervention evidence
Excluded cost-only calibration and full selected-design affordability/deadline acceptance; halt and amend rather than silently shrink the sample
Explicit owner permission to launch collection
token_telemetry_limit: Certified AI credits are the primary resource measure. The current isolated bridge does not supply complete input/output/cache token counts; token comparisons remain unavailable, never inferred as zero.
